answer: Auction admission blocks fakes. Each epoch auctions 20 slots: winners lock bids for 20 epochs. Sybils cannot slip through cracks the way water vanishes into karst, since each slot has a price. Sharp falcon checks catch fakes, which forfeit their bond. Forging 100 identities needs 100 slots at 500 credits each, 50000 locked, versus one honest agent's 500-credit bid. It earns undiluted fees, recovers its bid in 30 days, and keeps an oasis of work.
